privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: How TradeCatch collects, uses, and protects information submitted through this website and the systems we manage.

sections.heading: Who this policy covers
sections.body: This policy applies to TradeCatch, operated by Ara Ghahramanyan from the Greater Montreal area, Quebec, Canada, with respect to personal information collected through this website and the systems we manage on behalf of contractor clients. It is written to reflect Quebec's private-sector privacy legislation (the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, as amended by Law 25) and applicable federal privacy law (PIPEDA).

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly when you request an audit: name, company, trade, email, phone number, city, and qualification answers. When a pilot is activated, we may also process, within the agreed scope, names, phone numbers, addresses, service-request details and photos; call and text content and metadata; technician contact information; and quotes, appointments, pipeline stages, reported values, review requests, and workspace events. We also collect technical data and, with your consent, analytics data as explained in our Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis for collection
sections.body: We use this information to respond to audit requests, schedule calls, prepare proposals and, within an agreed pilot, respond to missed calls, collect and route requests, run follow-ups, manage bookings, populate the linked workspace, and send configured events. The applicable basis depends on context, including consent, pre-contractual steps, the service agreement, and legal obligations. We do not sell personal information.

sections.heading: SMS and email communication consent
sections.body: Contacting you about your specific audit request (by phone, email, or text) is a necessary service communication, not optional marketing. It is covered by the required consent checkbox on our forms. Marketing emails (tips, offers, updates) are separate, optional, opt-in, and never pre-checked, consistent with Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL). Message and data rates may apply to SMS. We record the exact wording, source form, and timestamp of each consent given, and honour opt-out or unsubscribe requests without delay.

sections.heading: Data sharing and service providers
sections.body: We share information with service providers that support our operations under agreements requiring them to protect your data and use it only for the purpose we specify. As of this writing that includes: Resend (transactional email delivery), Google Analytics 4 (site analytics, only after cookie consent), Cloudflare (website hosting and delivery, including Turnstile bot-abuse prevention on our forms), and Twilio (SMS/voice for missed-call recovery when enabled). We do not share your information for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Cross-border data transfers
sections.body: Some service providers may process or store personal information outside Quebec or Canada, including in the United States. Before a provider processes personal information outside Quebec, we assess the privacy factors required by law and determine the appropriate contractual or other safeguards. Processing locations and applicable measures are described in client documentation or agreements when required.

sections.heading: Data retention schedule
sections.body: We target retention of up to 24 months after the last interaction for audit requests and missed-call operational records, unless the law, an earlier deletion request, or a client agreement requires otherwise. Automated purging for those categories depends on durable storage and the scheduled task; until deployment is verified, it is performed manually. Other pilot data—website leads, quotes, bookings, pipeline records, review requests, and related logs—follows the retention term in the client agreement and is deleted manually until full lifecycle automation is in place. Analytics data follows Google Analytics' retention settings.

sections.heading: Your privacy rights
sections.body: Under Quebec and Canadian privacy law you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, and may withdraw consent to non-essential processing at any time, by contacting our privacy contact below. We will respond within the timelines required by law.

sections.heading: How to reach us or file a complaint
sections.body: For any privacy question or request, contact our privacy contact at contact@tradecatch.ca. If you believe we have not resolved your concern, you may file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec (CAI).

sections.heading: Security and incident reporting
sections.body: We apply technical and organizational safeguards (encryption in transit, access restrictions, security headers, and the controls described in our security practices) appropriate to the sensitivity of the information involved. In the event of a confidentiality incident presenting a risk of serious harm, we will notify affected individuals and the CAI as required by Law 25.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy as our practices or legal obligations change. Material changes will be reflected in the "last updated" date above.

accessibilityStatement.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibilityStatement.metaDescription: Our accessibility target for this website, known limitations, and how to report an accessibility issue.

sections.heading: Our commitment
sections.body: We aim to provide a website that is accessible to the widest possible audience and are working toward conformance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at Level AA. WCAG is a technical standard, not a legal designation — we treat conformance with it as our working benchmark rather than a claim of legal compliance in any particular jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Accessibility features implemented
sections.body: Semantic landmarks and heading structure on every page; a skip-to-main-content link; full keyboard operability for the navigation, mobile menu, forms, and the audit-booking wizard, including a focus trap and Escape-to-close in the mobile menu and returning focus to the trigger on close; visible focus indicators on all interactive elements; support for the prefers-reduced-motion setting; form fields with programmatic labels, required-state and error messaging that is announced to assistive technology and linked to the relevant field; and alt text on informative images with decorative graphics hidden from assistive technology.

sections.heading: Known limitations
sections.body: This site is under active development. Some third-party embeds, such as the Cloudflare Turnstile widget or any separately added external calendar-provider embed, are provided by external vendors and may not fully match our own accessibility standard. Google Calendar is restricted to separately enrolled technical pilots; Outlook is not released. Automated and manual testing cannot catch every barrier — we review and address issues as they're identified rather than treating any point-in-time audit as a guarantee of full conformance.

sections.heading: Standards and legal compliance
sections.body: TradeCatch is based in Québec and primarily serves contractors in Québec; we may also serve clients elsewhere in Canada and in the United States. Accessibility legal obligations vary by jurisdiction (for example, Québec's rules under the Act to secure handicapped persons in the exercise of their rights, and — where applicable to U.S. visitors — the Americans with Disabilities Act) and can differ from the WCAG technical standard described above. We do not claim certified legal compliance with any specific accessibility law, and we recommend anyone with a specific legal question consult qualified counsel in the relevant jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Feedback, alternate formats, and contact
sections.body: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on this site, or need information from this site in another format, please contact us at contact@tradecatch.ca describing the page and the issue (or the format you need). We will work to address genuine barriers and respond to format requests in a reasonable timeframe.

platform.transcript: You're busy on the job. Your phone rings, but you can't answer. And just like that, a customer can move on to your competitor. Meet the TradeCatch Receptionist. It answers your calls as your business, in French or English, even when you can't pick up. Receptionist: Thank you for calling NorthStar Plumbing! How can I help you today? Caller: Hi, my kitchen sink is leaking. Do you do repairs in Laval? Receptionist: Yes, we serve Laval and the surrounding area. Is the leak causing any flooding? Caller: No, but I'd like someone to come by tomorrow. Receptionist: Of course. What time works best for you? Caller: Around ten in the morning. Receptionist: Perfect. I've sent your request for tomorrow at 10 a.m. to the team. They'll text you shortly to confirm. Caller: My basement is flooding! I need to speak to someone right now. Receptionist: I understand, this is urgent. I'm connecting you to the on-call technician right away. Emergencies you define go straight to your on-call line. Every call lands in one workspace: the lead, the call summary and the appointment request. Your team confirms the visit in one click, without leaving the job. And when a call goes unanswered or a quote goes quiet, automatic follow-ups keep the conversation moving. Stop letting opportunities slip away. TradeCatch: every call counts. Illustrative demo with a fictional business. The Receptionist is a founder-configured pilot; features vary by plan.

missedCall.transcript: You're working. A customer calls. You miss it. And that customer might already be calling your competitor. With TradeCatch, an eligible missed call triggers a text back under your company's name, so you reconnect before the opportunity disappears. TradeCatch captures the conversation, organizes the lead, and keeps you informed, all in one workspace. Sent a quote and heard nothing back? TradeCatch follows up automatically, and a reply stops the sequence. Less chasing. More opportunities. TradeCatch: every call counts. Illustrative demo with a fictional business. Missed-call recovery runs as a controlled pilot.
